grammarFocus: 关系从句；指代；可能性表达；复杂句主干辨认。
title: The Library Garden Project
instructions: 这是一份模拟听力练习（非官方雅思测试），主题为“自然与阅读推断”，语法重点为关系从句、指代、可能性表达和复杂句主干辨认。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答10个问题。题目类型包括单选、填空、匹配（以单选形式）和判断正误/未提及。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文，并附原文证据。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lisa. You look busy. What's that big plan on your desk?
W: It's for the library garden project. We're turning the empty yard behind the library into a reading garden. The idea is that people can sit outside and read among plants.
M: That sounds lovely. Who's in charge?
W: Well, I thought I was, but actually the head librarian, Mrs. Chen, is leading it. I'm just helping with the design.
M: I see. So what's the plan for the garden?
W: We want to create different areas. There will be a quiet corner with benches under a big tree, a small vegetable patch that children can help with, and a reading circle where we can hold story time.
M: A vegetable patch? In a library garden?
W: Yes, it's for the children's gardening club. They'll grow tomatoes and beans. It's meant to teach them about nature while they read.
M: That's a nice idea. But isn't the yard very shady?
W: It is, but we've chosen plants that grow well in shade, like ferns and hostas. We might also add some colourful pots to brighten it up.
M: And who will look after the garden?
W: A group of volunteers, mostly parents and older students. They'll take turns watering and weeding. We're also hoping to get some help from a local garden centre.
M: When will it be finished?
W: If everything goes to plan, by the end of June. But it could take longer if we don't get enough volunteers.
M: I could help. I'm not great at gardening, but I can paint benches.
W: That would be great! We need someone to paint the benches and the sign. Thanks, Tom.
M: No problem. Oh, one more thing—will the garden be open to everyone?
W: Yes, during library hours. But we might need to limit numbers at busy times. We'll see.
M: Sounds sensible. Good luck with it!
W: Thanks!

grammar.title: 关系从句、指代、可能性表达与复杂句主干辨认
grammar.explanation: 关系从句用来修饰名词，例如“a reading garden where people can sit”中where引导的从句修饰garden。指代要注意代词指代什么，如“They'll take turns”中的They指volunteers。可能性表达用might, could, may等表示不确定，如“We might need to limit numbers”。复杂句要先找主干，如“If everything goes to plan, by the end of June”中主干是“it will be finished by the end of June”（省略了it will be finished）。
grammar.example: We might also add some colourful pots to brighten it up.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun: The library garden, ___ is behind the building, will open in June.
questions.explanation: 先行词是the library garden，指物，在从句中作主语，用which。

questions.prompt: What does 'They' refer to in: 'A group of volunteers... They'll take turns watering'?
questions.explanation: They指代前一句的a group of volunteers。

questions.prompt: Which sentence expresses possibility, not certainty?
options: The garden will open in June.
We might need to limit numbers.
answers: We might need to limit numbers.

questions.prompt: Identify the main clause: 'If everything goes to plan, by the end of June, the garden will be finished.'
questions.explanation: 主句是the garden will be finished，if引导的是条件状语从句。
